source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of postfix evaluation (PDF 98-99).

items: Khali stack se shuru kar ke postfix expression baen se daen parhein.
Operator: zaroori operands pop kar ke amal karein aur nateeja push karein.
Aakhir mein stack par bachi qeemat jawab hai.

blocks.text: Misal: 3 4 5 * +. 3, 4 aur 5 push: [3, 4, 5]. * parha: 5 aur 4 pop, 4 x 5 = 20, push: [3, 20]. + parha: 20 aur 3 pop, 3 + 20 = 23, push: [23]. Jawab 23.

blocks.alt: 3 4 5 * + ko baen se daen parhte hue stack: 3 push, 4 push, 5 push; * par 5 aur 4 nikal kar 20 push (stack 3, 20); + par 20 aur 3 nikal kar 23 push. Aakhir mein stack mein sirf 23.
blocks.caption: Postfix 3 4 5 * + ka hisab karte hue stack ki halatein (asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

items: Postfix nikalna: adad push; operator do pop kar ke hisab kar ke push; 3 4 5 * + = 23.
